tea.title: Kew: The history of tea, From China to India
tea.used_for: Singpho knowledge, Robert and Charles Bruce; account quotes and identifies Charles Bruce’s 1839 report.

labour.title: Rana Pratap Behal, Labour Resistance in Indenture Plantations in the Assam Valley, in Beyond Indenture (Cambridge, 2023)
labour.used_for: Indenture, recruitment and labour resistance; read with KKHSOU Tea World and the 2024 CAG tea-community report.

oil.title: IndianOil: Digboi Refinery
oil.used_for: Refinery commissioned in 1901; distinguish discovery, drilling and refining.

rail.title: Rail Enthusiasts’ Society: Railway Heritage Park, Tinsukia
rail.used_for: Dibru–Sadiya Railway and transport/resource context; only decade-level railway opening date used.

phulaguri.title: Rajiv Gandhi University IDE, History of North East India (1228–1947), printed p.132, PDF p.139
phulaguri.used_for: Phulaguri petition, raijmel, October 1861 confrontation; casualty totals explicitly not treated as unanimous.

patharughat.title: MyGov: Peasants’ Uprising of Patharughat
patharughat.used_for: 28 January 1894, Darrang and increased land revenue; popular commemoration distinguished from colonial casualty returns.

seba.title: SEBA Class X Social Science History Part I, chapter 3
seba.used_for: Rangia and Lachima resistance; 21 January 1894 Lachima confrontation. Search-index extract consulted; full PDF fetch timed out.

archives.title: International Council on Archives, Guide to Sources of Asian History: India, Assam State Archives section
archives.used_for: Assam administrative chronology: 1874, 1905, 1912, 1921; checked against Assam State Archives guides in the source library.

constitution.title: Government of India Act chronology and Constitution of India
constitution.used_for: Historical constitutional framework. The linked Assam legislative catalogue is a discovery/index source; 1919 dyarchy and 1935 provincial autonomy are also covered by RGU’s textbook, PDF pp.133–137. Constitution commencement is the historical date 26 January 1950.

migration.title: Calcutta Research Group: Refugee Watch 41, colonial Assam settlement discussion
migration.used_for: The colonial Line System around 1920; distinct from the Inner Line. No inference of any individual’s present citizenship.

innerline.title: Ministry of Home Affairs: Bengal Eastern Frontier Regulation, 1873
innerline.used_for: Historical regulation and Inner Line entry control; no current permit advice is offered.

census.title: Census of India 1931: Assam, Report Part I
census.used_for: Colonial census categories and commentary, read critically. Catalogue record identifies the primary report; no unverified numerical migration total is taught.

language.title: Uncharted Terrains, Assamese education discussion, printed p.148 onward
language.used_for: Assamese language policy, educational advocacy and the 1873 restoration convention.

orunodoi.title: Gauhati University CDOE, media history study material MMC-1025
orunodoi.used_for: Orunodoi at Sivasagar, 1846; Nathan Brown and Oliver Cutter. Also identified in source-library research.

dictionary.title: Source-library dossiers: Miles Bronson and Hemchandra Baruah
dictionary.used_for: 1867 Bronson dictionary bibliographic record; Hemkosh 1900 cross-checked with the IIT Guwahati-associated catalogue. Assamese editorial review remains pending.

restoration.title: Assam State Archives: General records 1874–1932
restoration.used_for: Distinguishes 1873 restoration convention from specific 1874 implementation records; archive guide is a locator, not a quotation of every original order.

jonaki.title: Gauhati University CDOE, ENG 4046, modern Assamese literature
jonaki.used_for: Orunodoi and Jonaki literary phases, 1846 and 1889. Editor and trio also cross-checked against source-library biographies.

bezbaroa.title: IIT Guwahati Board of Governors, meeting 78, item 21/2014
bezbaroa.used_for: Rasaraj for humorous/satirical writing and Kripabar persona; works corroborated by Kalakshetra museum catalogue.

sabha.title: Asam Sahitya Sabha: history and first presidency
sabha.used_for: 1917, Sivasagar and Padmanath Gohain Baruah; corroborated by source-library biography and institutional manuscript collection at Tezpur University.

association.title: Gita Devi, History MPhil dissertation, political associations section
association.used_for: Assam Association organisers and first-session presidency; 1903 formation and 1905 inaugural session distinguished.

students.title: Asom Chhatra Sanmilan centenary reporting
students.used_for: 1916, Guwahati and Bezbaroa’s first-session presidency; this is commemorative reporting, not a meeting minute.

women.title: M. Sharma, Gendered Publics: Chandraprava Saikiani and the Mahila Samiti in Colonial Assam, Oxford University Press (2023), introduction
women.used_for: Assam Mahila Samiti, 1926 and women’s public organising; read with Tezpur University’s Chandraprabha Saikiani Centre account and institutional scholarship.

apcc.title: Assam Pradesh Congress Committee: A Brief History
apcc.used_for: APCC formation, 1921 Gandhi visit and 1926 Pandu session. Party institutional account; cross-read with scholarship rather than treating its evaluations as neutral.

swadeshi.title: National movement chronology: Swadeshi and boycott
swadeshi.used_for: National movement background; boycott, khadi and Non-Cooperation context. Assam provincial boundary dates are separately sourced.

noncoop.title: RGU IDE, History of North East India, PDF pp.140–145
noncoop.used_for: Assam mobilisation, Nabin Chandra Bordoloi, Tarun Ram Phukan and the Non-Cooperation programme.

civil.title: Census of India 1931, Assam, political-events discussion
civil.used_for: Contemporary colonial acknowledgement of Assam’s Non-Cooperation and 1930 Civil Disobedience; commentary read critically.

national.title: Publications Division: Civil Disobedience Movement chronology
national.used_for: 1930 pledge, Gandhi–Irwin Pact and resumed Civil Disobedience in 1932; national chronology for Assam’s regional story.

quit.title: Ministry of Culture/ICHR, Dictionary of Martyrs, volume 4 (2019)
quit.used_for: Assam Quit India episodes and biographies; no invented words or quotations are attributed to martyrs.

kanaklata.title: PIB, Amrit Mahotsav series 08: Kanaklata Barua

bhogeswari.title: Dictionary of Martyrs, volume 4: Bhogeswari Phukanani entry
bhogeswari.used_for: Nagaon/Barhampur episode in September 1942; exact death-day disagreement avoided in the exercises.

dhekiajuli.title: Dictionary of Martyrs, volume 4: Dhekiajuli entries, printed p.425
dhekiajuli.used_for: Dhekiajuli procession and young martyrs; Tileswari’s surname varies in public accounts. Barua follows common Assam exam usage; the dictionary indexes Tileswari Koch.

kushal.title: Dictionary of Martyrs, volume 4: Kushal Konwar, printed p.219
kushal.used_for: Sarupathar case, disputed proof of guilt, execution at Jorhat on 15 June 1943.

war.title: National Army Museum: The Far East campaign
war.used_for: Burma crisis, 1944 Imphal–Kohima battles and Allied resistance; regional military chronology.

ledo.title: Changlang district: Stilwell Road (Ledo Road)
ledo.used_for: Ledo–Burma–China route, Kunming connection and General Joseph Stilwell; no disputed exact opening date taught.

ina.title: Bishnupur district: INA Memorial Moirang
ina.used_for: 14 April 1944 flag raising at Moirang. Does not claim an unqualified first flag anywhere in Indian territory.

grouping.title: Nehru to Gopinath Bardoloi, 22 July and 23 September 1946
grouping.used_for: Primary correspondence on compulsory grouping, provincial autonomy and the Assam Assembly resolution; companion September letter consulted.

gandhi.title: Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi: Talk with Assam deputation, before 16 October 1946
gandhi.used_for: Assam and compulsory grouping; also read against Nehru correspondence.

partition.title: Yojana, April 2018, Sylhet referendum discussion
partition.used_for: 6–7 July 1947 referendum, majority for East Bengal and the district’s Partition context; boundary outcome distinguished from the vote.

notes: Historical and Assamese editorial review status is recorded in each lesson.
No fabricated PYQ labels or human-review claims.
Catalogue/index sources are distinguished from actual primary passages.
